entry.title: New: dsh-powerdesk
entry.summary: A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search. Exact install spec: github:fleetingecho/dsh-powerdesk. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
